BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to streamlining Washington state's technologyefforts; adding a new section to chapter 28B.38 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 28B.20 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 28B.30RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 43.21F RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.38 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to provide more focus and efficient effortof resources by centralizing technology missions and reducingadministrative overhead of the Spokane intercollegiate research andtechnology institute. The state currently has a variety of entitieswith conflicting or overlapping missions that cause confusion andwastes tax dollars.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to provide more focus and efficient effortof resources by centralizing technology missions and reducing p. 1 HB 3116administrative overhead of the Washington technology center. The statecurrently has a variety of entities with conflicting or overlappingmissions that cause confusion and wastes tax dollars.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to provide more focus and efficient effortof resources by centralizing technology missions and reducingadministrative overhead of the Washington State University energyprogram. The state currently has a variety of entities withconflicting or overlapping missions that cause confusion and wastes taxdollars.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21F RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to provide more focus and efficient effortof resources by centralizing technology missions and reducingadministrative overhead of the department of community, trade, andeconomic development's energy policy office. The state currently hasa variety of entities with conflicting or overlapping missions thatcause confusion and wastes tax dollars.
